overview: This file documents U.S. occupation efforts to dismantle Japan’s zaibatsu and assess its industrial capacity. Mission correspondence and reports are followed by copies of prewar agreements between Japanese and foreign firms. The contracts reveal how patents, technical knowledge, manufacturing rights, and royalties circulated across industries and Japanese-controlled territories.
interest: The collected contracts expose the foreign technology and territorial rights behind Japanese industry, alongside occupation officials’ efforts to dismantle concentrated ownership.
